scheme_name: Petrol Subsidy To Persons With Disability
other_conditions: Must be a person with disability who owns a motorized vehicle.
Applicants receiving any conveyance allowance (voluntary or government) are ineligible.
Maximum subsidy limited to 20 litres of petrol/diesel per month.
benefits_summary: Provides a 50% subsidy on actual petrol/diesel expenditure up to a maximum of 20 litres per month for eligible persons with disability.
